scope: One sample per typology; citation existence checks only until separate evidence review; not an accuracy benchmark.

checks.question: Explain structuring and two risk indicators an AML analyst should investigate. Distinguish suspicious patterns from proof and date any historical ruling.
Explain money mule accounts and two transaction indicators an AML analyst should investigate. Do not infer criminality from nationality or occupation alone.
Explain trade-based money laundering and two invoice or payment indicators an AML analyst should investigate. Distinguish FATF indicators from US legal requirements.
Explain how shell and front companies can be misused and two warning indicators. Explain why shell companies are not automatically illicit.
Explain digital asset investment scam laundering and two financial indicators for bank analysts. Distinguish scam victim payments from laundering-network activity.
Explain laundering of foreign public corruption proceeds and two financial indicators for bank analysts. Why is one red flag not conclusive?
Explain human trafficking-related financial flows and two financial indicators for bank analysts. Why is a single red flag insufficient?
